title: Evergreen fix plan v1
description: The patches `evergreen fix` would apply to a repository, the fixer behind each one, and the findings the fixers left unchanged with the reason. Reading a repository only; the plan never includes network access or a written file.

patches.description: Unified diffs ordered by path, so the array pipes into `git apply` when the patches are concatenated.

path.description: Repository-relative path, exactly as the diff header names it.

diff.description: One hunk that `git apply` accepts, starting with its `--- a/` header line.

fixer.description: Stable id of the fixer that produced the patch, such as `runtime-pins`.

refusals.description: Findings a fixer recognized as its own and left unchanged, ordered by path, line, finding id, and fixer. A finding outside every fixer's scope is not a refusal and is not listed.

fixer.description: Stable id of the fixer that declined the finding.

findingId.description: The scan's finding id, so the refusal joins the finding in `scan --json`.

reason.description: Short explanation of why the finding was left unchanged; deterministic for the same repository and data.
